tasks.title: Founder Business Bank Account & Legal KYC Integration

humanQA.q:
**Please complete your business banking, KYC verification, and inject API keys directly.**

AI agents cannot legally access personal bank accounts, initiate money transfers, or sign KYC documents.

- Complete KYC on your bank / Stripe / Razorpay merchant account.
- Add production API tokens (`VERCEL_TOKEN`, `COMPOSIO_API_KEY`) to `$AGENT_DIR/.env`.
- Authorize financial disbursements from your personal banking app.

**Bank & KYC regulatory security requires you to complete verification or paste the API credentials directly.**

AI agents cannot legally hold biometric ID, pass OTP verification, or bypass banking regulations.

- Perform KYC directly at your bank/gateway dashboard.
- Or add your gateway API keys (`RAZORPAY_KEY_ID`, `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`) to `hive/agents/god/.env`.
